name: Validate parent chat exclusion logic
description:
# Summary

The task was to update the `findChildChatByFile` method in the chat service to validate that the found child chat is not the parent chat itself. The solution adds a check `node.id !== chat?.id` to the search condition, ensuring the method excludes the parent chat from results even if it contains the specified file. This prevents the method from incorrectly returning the parent chat as a child, maintaining proper chat hierarchy validation.
